column1: # Known problem replays of the replay detection (ReplayDetectionTest, corpusTest): the replays of this folder (detection/).
# One line per replay that is not ok: <id> TAB <class: suspicious or error> TAB <signals at the detection> TAB <note>.
# <id> is the replay's id in this folder (detection/<source>/<id>.rep); write it as detection/<id> in every text.
# A replay that is not listed must be ok; a listed replay must keep its class. Remove an entry when its replay becomes ok.
# Signals are <signal>@<first frame> (failure, eud_failure, restart, length, selection, foreign, order, target, defeat).
